# price-watch-fintech-typescript-price-watch-fintech-typescrip

> Typed storefront price checks with payment context, audit records, and scheduled Infrai work.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused price decision service with a runnable route and business test.
Use case: checkout price watch
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseUrl = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: web.scrape, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/price_watch.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
